items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: No, no relation. There were no relations. ... There's several of them. There's three Mike Lala's.

ctx.x: No, no relation. There were no relations. No. Now listen, Pete Lala's name, he was not Pete Lala. It was Pete Sika Sika. But he just gave him that name, Pete Lala. Pete Lala, I think he was a relative of the trumpet player. Who? Johnny Lala was it?
Well, there's several of them. There's three Mike Lala's. I know three Mike Lala's. Tell about Tom Anderson. Tell now, tell us about Tom Anderson. What's that for you? Well...

Mr. Tom Anderson sent for me. His... My wife's... ...lady friend, I'll say. ...was Gertrude Dix. She ran... The house was called a brass railing. It was right next... ...to Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. Mr. Anderson's Annex Saloon. And, uh... I went to wake over there for her. Miss Dix. Well, I played there... ...about... ...or around about... ...eight or nine months.
